Indian ships navigate Hormuz Strait amid conflict, carrying vital cargo

Multiple Indian ships have successfully transited the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil chokepoint, amidst ongoing conflict and "bombing barrages." So far, 44 Indian vessels have passed through, with 15 more reportedly in line. These ships are carrying essential goods including oil, LPG, and fertilizers, which are crucial for India's economy and agriculture.
